messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR to refresh the SDK snippets for streaming+pagination+retry patterns across py/ts/go. Need a quick triage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4122 :eyes:
Alex: I can pick up the TypeScript snippets. Do we want to switch to the promise-iterator example or keep the async generator sample?
Maria: Prefer promise-iterator for TS because it's what our SDK uses now. Keep the old async generator as a short note for backwards-compat.
Jordan: I'll own the Go side. Any tests expected or just the docs examples? Go snippets should compile with go1.21 and the minimal deps.
Sam: I'll do Python. We should add an example using the streaming client with resume tokens + exponential backoff retry. Small runnable snippet is ideal.
Eli: Quick question: are we standardizing the retry backoff config shape? I saw variations in previous PRs (max_retries vs retries, backoff_ms vs backoff).
Maria: Good catch. Use the config shape in the runtime SDK reference: {"retries": 3, "backoff": "exponential"} — please mirror that in examples and call out the default behavior.
Alex: TS snippet draft:
```ts
const stream = client.stream.create({model: 'redwood-alpha', stream: true});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
I'll add the promise-iterator wrapper and a tiny note about cancellation.
Jordan: Go draft (WIP):
```go
resp, err := client.Stream(ctx, &inference.Request{Model: "redwood-alpha"})
for resp.Next() {
  fmt.Print(resp.Chunk().Text)
}
```
I'll run `golangci-lint run` before pushing.
Sam: Python draft:
```py
with client.stream(model='redwood-alpha') as s:
    for part in s:
        print(part.text, end='')
```
I'll also include a resume-token toy: `s.resume(token)` example and a retry wrapper using `tenacity`.
Eli: DocsBot note — crosslink checklist: ensure each snippet has: 1) one-line description, 2) required deps, 3) expected output, 4) test harness entry.
DocsBot: Automated checklist for PR #4122: snippets present for py/ts/go, lint checks queued, linkcheck pending. See CI run: https://ci.redwood-inference/run/4122
Maria: Team scope/timeline: aim to merge by EOD Fri. If anyone hits blockers ping me and label with `docs:blocked`. Also please add commit prefix `docs(sdk-snippets):` so release notes pick it up.
Alex: Noted. Will open a small follow-up PR if lint complains instead of pushing huge changes.
Jordan: FYI found a small API mismatch in Go client for resume tokens — filing an issue and will reference it in the PR.
Sam: I'll add a tiny pytest that imports the snippet as a doctest so the CI will surface syntax errors.
Eli: I'll review once CI is green, focusing on wording around retry guarantees and at-least-once delivery caveats.
Maria: Thanks all — assigning reviewers: @Eli for API accuracy, @Sam for python style, @Jordan for Go nuance, @Alex for TS patterns.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :shipit:
Sam: will push my branch in ~2 hours
DocsBot: PR merged checklist will post here when complete.
